# Data Upload {#data-upload}

In this section we assume:

* you correctly followed and completed the steps in the [Digitising Data Section](#digitising-data),
* you have been trained by a member of the ForestPlots' team to upload data, and
* you are preparing data for upload, either by yourself or through a ForestPlots team member.

## Data upload format

The way in which you format ForestPlots' data varies depending on 

* whether your plot is new to or already exists in ForestPlots and 
* how many censuses there are to upload. 

Specifically, in ForestPlots, there are four different types of data:

The figure above can help you identify which upload format you need. The format template can be viewed and downloaded using the table below:

| Type of Data    | Where to find the data format |
|-----------------|-------------------------------|
| New plots with a single census.                   | Uses the [Bulk Import:  Single Census Plots](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx?src=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.forestplots.net%2FSiteTemplates%2Fen%2FMultiPlotImportTreeTemplate.xlsx&wdOrigin=BROWSELINK) template available in the **Data Import** section of ForestPlots.net. |
| New plots with two or more censuses               | Uses the [Bulk Import: Multi-Census Plot Data](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx?src=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.forestplots.net%2FSiteTemplates%2Fen%2FPlotMultiCensusImportTemplate.xlsx&wdOrigin=BROWSELINK) template available in the **Data Import** section of ForestPlots.net. |
| Existing plots with one additional census.        | Uses the tree field sheet for the plot, which can be downloaded from the **Data Export** section of the plots page on ForestPlots.net. |
| Existing plots with multiple additional censuses. | Uses the [Bulk Import: Multi-Census Plot Data](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx?src=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.forestplots.net%2FSiteTemplates%2Fen%2FPlotMultiCensusImportTemplate.xlsx&wdOrigin=BROWSELINK)|
| Liana data                                        | Visit the designated [lianas page](#lianas) for upload instructions, but lianas use this template: [Import Liana Plot Census Data](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx?src=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.forestplots.net%2FSiteTemplates%2Fen%2FLianaCensusImportTemplate.xlsx&wdOrigin=BROWSELINK).|
